full_page.content:
Page 150
June 6 Mrs. Marian Hickey - 40 - breast removed about three yrs. ago; recently they removed a small cancer from behind ear.
6 Leo Lawlebur - 58 - bleeding ulcer of Stomach - has wife and 3 de- pending on him - Drs. hopeless (% phone)
Christine Maisano - 5 - "medits-enemia" Drs gave her two months to live .... enrolled perpetually in Ser. Masses.
7 Mary Rose Tocco - 13 - "inseflitis" a kind of stroke three yrs ago but after 3 months quite recovered; now for two years unable to walk even with crutches; enrolled Tonight.
7 Henry Youngblood - 41 - hopelessly cancerous .... 9th H. Y. retained supper last night ... Wife makes donation of $100.00
Eliz Karschnie - 21 - has been away nine months without even phon- ing or writing to mother In positively bad company ... Enrolled To-day $5.
Clara Hartman - 28 - married out of the Church and violently ill -T.B.
Page 151 Jun.9th Thomas E. Kastead - 38 - in the South Sea service - needed very sore- ly at home.
Angeline Kowaleski - 32 - T.B. in Kiefer's
13 Maureen Doyle - 6 - tonsel and adnoid operation to-morrow.
15 Dave Pollard - 63 - serious kidney trouble, delerious "no hope" .....
15 Mrs. Mary Yovanovich - 62 - Othodox - Gall-blad. - married in Orthodox near fifty years; Now in danger insists on being Catholic - figuering of operation tomorrow.
16 Linda Pajak - 4 - Spinal maningitis - developed from pneumonia.
17 Richard Shields - 19 - in Camp for Eight months ... wants to get back to the Seminary ... now decided without hesitation "of brilliant mind" - Enrolled Today 5.
Page 152 June 18 Mrs. Amelia Leonard - 48 - of Bay City - serious stomach and head- aches.
